As the sun and moon pass over the golden woods, winds from the distant plains leave their mark on the ancient stone walls. Beneath the stillness, something remains sealed within the ruins.
At the highest point of the layered peaks, an ancient massive cube still stands atop the mountain. Legend says this was once a sacred place, though those who once came here are long gone.
As time passes, grand halls crumble into ruin. Among the broken walls by the cliff, traces of the past can still be seen.
Storms once wore down the rocks, lightning carved the cliffs, and time gently healed them, as grass and trees softened the land’s scars.
Soil and stone have buried the ancient temple, while grass and trees have covered the traces of human activity, leaving only half of a strange, jagged boulder exposed.
Under the gaze of countless travelers, the ruins by the roadside have stood quietly for a thousand years, untouched by wind, rain, or lightning.
As the tide strikes the shore, traces of ancient ruins can be glimpsed between the white surf and pink reefs.
An ancient secret lies buried beneath the Mistwoods, and every flower and tree seems to guard the heart of the forest.
Ancient ruins divide the yellow and green earth, where the cool tones of the mountains meet the warmth of the plains.
Ancient canopies weave a dark green dome, scattering daylight into moss-cracked hollows, where silent eyes watch passing travelers.
Pebbles borne by the wind have scoured the stone for ages, leaving only a patch of primal bareness. In time, they too will crack and fade, until even these marks vanish without a trace.
The honest and gentle Panpantas can unleash astonishing strength when defending its nest. Respawn Interval: 20s
The sturdy and steady Tubster stands firm against the wind and waves along the coast. Respawn Interval: 20s
The tenacious Ignitis lies in wait within the shadows. Respawn interval: 20s (spawns at night)
